snippet.title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage Trailer
snippet.description:
Crossplay functionality lets you brawl it out with players on any platform.
Additionally, online matches will run more seamlessly than ever,thanks to rollback netcode, allowing you to engage in intense battles with opponents all over the world!

World Stage
In the all-new immersive singleplayer mode, you'll travel the globe and compete in a massive tournament.
Along the way, you'll encounter formidable foes, including CPUs based on world-renowned players.
Climb up the ranks and claim the title of world champion!


Pick up the Steam version of Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. here!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3112260/Virtua_Fighter_5_REVO/

Official X Account:
https://x.com/vf_official
